title: Zombie City - HD Isometric Tileset
author: SmallScaleInt
summary: Isometric HD zombie-city tileset whose page documents over 1000 tiles plus animations, delivered as one 170 MB RAR of graphics only. Movement code and enemy AI are not included; the example scene is a separate Unity product.
engineNote: The page lists one 170 MB RAR container and does not name an engine project or inner file formats, so this is recorded as an unverified archive rather than a Unity, Unreal or Godot package. Extract the sheets and rebuild tile collisions, autotiling rules and animation frames in your engine; the creator notes the package contains graphics only, with no movement code or enemy AI.
